app.tagline: Your business website, made by talking.
home.title: {app_name}
home.intro: Tell us about your business by voice or send a photo of your price list. We build a website that works well on phones, test it the way your customers will, and show you how ready it is.
home.step_1: Speak in Marathi, Hindi or English, or send a photo of your rate card.
home.step_2: Check each detail. Nothing goes on your site until you say yes.
home.step_3: Get a live website with a readiness score.
lang.label: Language

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: {app_name} helps small businesses make a website. This page explains what we store, why, for how long, and how to delete it.
privacy.why: To build and run the business website, to pass customer enquiries to the business, and to keep the service secure and working.
privacy.store_title: What we store and for how long
privacy.voice: Voice recordings: deleted right after processing, unless the owner agreed to keep them.
privacy.profile: Business profile, photos and website: kept until the owner deletes the site.
privacy.enquiries: Customer enquiries (name, phone number and message): kept for 90 days.
privacy.delete_owner: Owners can delete their site and all its data with one action in their app.
privacy.delete_email: You can also ask us to delete data by writing to {email}.
site.sample_no_phone: Sample business: no real phone number
privacy.console_logs: Technical console log: a small log of about 2 MB, kept by size and overwritten automatically when full.
privacy.logs_redacted: Both logs are redacted and never contain recordings, secrets or full phone numbers.
score.title: Customer Readiness Score
score.pending_note: {points} more points will be added when the AI checks run.
score.check.cta_above_fold: Order button visible on a phone
score.check.no_sideways_scroll: No sideways scrolling on a phone
score.check.language_clarity: Price, delivery, contact and ordering are clear
score.check.area_shown: Delivery area shown, no home address
score.reason.content_time: On slow internet, the main content appeared in {seconds} seconds.
score.reason.cta_visible: On a phone, the order button is visible without scrolling.
score.reason.cta_below_fold: On a phone, customers have to scroll to see the order button.
score.reason.tap_targets_ok: Every button and link is big enough to tap.
score.reason.tap_targets_small: {count} buttons or links are smaller than 44 pixels.
score.reason.sideways_ok: The page does not scroll sideways on a phone.
score.reason.sideways_bad: The page scrolls sideways on a phone.
score.reason.laptop_ok: Nothing spills off the screen on a laptop.
score.reason.laptop_bad: {count} items spill off the screen on a laptop.
score.reason.phone_no: The phone number is not shown.
score.reason.phone_na: Not applicable: sample businesses have no real phone number.
score.reason.area_yes: The delivery area is shown, with no home address.
score.reason.area_no: No delivery or service area is shown.
score.reason.area_address: Something that looks like a home address is shown.
score.reason.https_yes: The site uses a secure connection (HTTPS).
score.reason.https_no: The site does not use a secure connection.
score.reason.https_na: Not applicable: checked only on the live site.
score.job.running: Testing the site like a customer…
score.job.failed: The test could not finish. Your site is unchanged. Please try again.
score.reason.photos_na: Not applicable: sample businesses use stock photos.
score.reason.language_summary: Across the three language pages: {yes} clear, {partly} partly clear, {no} unclear.
score.reason.ai_failed: The AI check could not run this time. Your site is unchanged; it will run again on the next test.
score.reason.ai_spend_cap: The AI check is resting for today. It will run again on the next test tomorrow.
score.reason.ai_refused: The AI check could not judge this page. It will try again on the next test.
score.reason.ai_invalid: The AI check gave an answer we could not read. It will run again on the next test.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions or feedback? Write to us and we will get back to you.
contact.name: Your name
contact.thanks: Thank you! Your message has been sent. We will get back to you soon.
contact.bad_contact: Please enter a valid email address or phone number.
mail.failed: We could not send the email right now. Your message is saved; please try again later.
privacy.emailed: Contact-form messages and business enquiries are also emailed to the {app_name} team's mailbox, and are covered by the same 90-day retention there.
stt.unavailable: Voice notes are not available right now. Please type instead.
stt.failed: We could not understand the recording. Please try again, or type instead.
stt.empty: We could not hear any words in this recording. Please try again, or type instead.
stt.no_mock: There is no saved transcript for this recording in demo mode. Please use a sample voice note, or type instead.
start.title: Tell us about your business
start.intro: Choose how you want to tell us. Speak in Marathi, Hindi or English, for up to 2 minutes: what you sell, your prices, your area and your WhatsApp number.
start.record_hint: Tap to start. Tap again to stop and send. Up to 2 minutes.
start.recording: Recording… tap to stop and send
start.no_mic: Recording is not available here. Please upload a voice note or type instead.
start.upload_photo: Photo of your price list or rate card
start.type_hint: Write what you sell, your prices, your area and your WhatsApp number.
start.samples: Or try a sample voice note
intake.consent: I agree that my business details, and my voice note or photo while it is being processed, are stored to make my website.
intake.keep_input: Keep my voice note or photo. (If you don't tick this, it is deleted as soon as it is processed.)
intake.consent_required: Please tick the box to agree before sending.
intake.text_length: Please write a little more about your business (at least 10 letters, at most 5000).
intake.extract_failed: We could not read your details this time. Please try again, or type instead.
wait.title: Working on it…
wait.hint: This can take up to 2 minutes. This page updates by itself.
confirm.title: Check your details
confirm.intro: Please check each detail and change anything that is wrong. Nothing goes on your website until you confirm.
confirm.name: Business name
confirm.delivery: Delivery or service areas (separate with commas)
confirm.from_photo: Read from your photo — please check this price
confirm.web_address_hint: Letters, numbers and hyphens only. You can change it.
confirm.photos: Your photos (optional, you can add them later)
confirm.photos_hint: Up to 8 photos. The first one is the main photo.
intake.price_invalid: Please write the price as a number, for example 450.
intake.price_needed: Please add a price, or remove this row.
intake.address_not_allowed: Please write your area name only, not your full address.
intake.address_invalid: Use 3 to 40 letters, numbers or hyphens.
intake.address_taken: This web address is already taken. Please choose another.
intake.q_area: Which area are you in? Please tell us the area name only, not your full address.
done.title: Your details are saved!
done.intro: Here is your private link and PIN. Save them now: we show the PIN only once.
done.save_hint: Tip: send them to yourself on WhatsApp, or take a screenshot.
done.next: Next, we will build your website. Nothing goes live until you say yes.
owner.pin_intro: Enter the 4-digit PIN we gave you.
owner.pin_wrong: That PIN is not right. Please try again.
owner.pin_locked: Too many wrong tries. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
owner.signin_required: Please open your private link and enter your PIN.
owner.pin_again: Please enter your PIN again to make this change.
owner.title: Your business
owner.status_draft: Your website is being prepared. Nothing is live yet.
owner.no_photos: No photos yet. You can add them any time.
photos.too_many: You can add up to 8 photos.

site.preview_note: This is a private preview. The enquiry form will work once the site is live.
owner.status_offline_note: Your website is offline. Customers can't see it right now.
owner.styles_intro: Pick the style you like. You can change it any time.
owner.scoring: Testing your site like a customer…
owner.score_failed: We couldn't test your site this time. Please try again.
publish.title: Make your site live?
publish.intro: Customers will see this site at the address below. You can undo this or take the site offline any time.

publish.sample_note: This is a sample business: the site shows a Sample banner and is deleted after 48 hours.
publish.not_published: Your site has not been published yet.
